name: sdd-plugin-suite
description: Spec-Driven Development (SDD) plugin suite — core workflows plus vibecoding utilities, from planning to implementation.

plugins.name: sdd
plugins.description: Core SDD workflow - spec-driven development from planning to implementation. Includes deep-spec, spec-to-task, feature-tdd, sdd-developer, feature-e2e-verifier, bug-fix, enhancement, and load-project-features skills.

plugins.name: vibecoding
plugins.description: Vibecoding utilities for glossary management, working conventions, and Playwright artifact cleanup. Includes ask-first, buy-before-build, glossary-builder, grounded-mode, using-glossary, and git-cleanup-playwright-artifacts skills.
